title: fix(components): RefreshIndicator requires its accessible name; four views pass a translated one (objectui#10580)
body:
Fixes #10580

Clause-②: yes

`RefreshIndicator`'s published `ariaLabel` prop loses its English default ("Refreshing") and becomes required, so a caller that passes no name is a type error instead of an English accessible name. This is the "declaration enforces" option the triage allowed on this PR (triage comment `5831898614`), taken by the seat's claim (`5832044126`). The four views that passed no name now pass their translated one. It is the objectui#3546 class: text a user meets that bypasses the translation layer.

## What changes

- `packages/components/src/custom/refresh-indicator.tsx`: `ariaLabel: string` is required, the `= "Refreshing"` default is gone, and the docblock says why.
- `ObjectGrid` passes `t('grid.refreshing')` and `ListView` passes `t('list.refreshing')`: the same keys, through the same hooks, that their pull-to-refresh text already reads. No new grid or list key.
- `ObjectChart` passes `t('chart.refreshing')`. The `t` comes from the `useObjectTranslation()` call the file already makes for `language`. It is deliberately not the file's `tt` (`useSafeTranslate`), because `tt` takes an English fallback string at every call, and the ruling is no English fallback anywhere.
- `ObjectDataTable` passes `t('dashboard.refreshing')` from the `useObjectTranslation()` call it already makes.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: `chart.refreshing` in the `chart` block and `dashboard.refreshing` at the `dashboard` block's top level, each placed after that block's `loading` key, in all ten packs. Each pack's value is the translation its own `grid.refreshing` already carries.
- `.changeset/10580-refresh-indicator-translated-name.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/components`, with the break stated as BREAKING (this repo marks its own breaking changes `minor`), and `patch` for `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-dashboard` and `i18n`. The changeset prose states the contract change, so a contract review is owed.

## Caller census (H4)

`git grep -n 'RefreshIndicator'` over the whole tree, re-run on the merged head `641ed9f`, finds five render sites. After this PR every one passes a translated name: `ObjectGrid`, `ListView`, `ObjectChart`, `ObjectDataTable`, and `ObjectGantt`, which already passed `t('gantt.aria.refreshing')` and is unchanged. Before this PR no other package, app, example, docs snippet or test rendered it. `RefreshIndicatorProps` has no other code reader; its one other mention is a docblock in `MetricWidget.tsx`. No docs page renders the component, so `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-types` have nothing of it to read and were not run. The sibling objectstack checkout has zero `RefreshIndicator` hits. The merge of `origin/main` brought in no new render site.

## H5

`ariaLabel=""` still type-checks, because the prop is a plain `string`. As ruled, no runtime check was added: the type is the gate.

## Pins

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/refresh-indicator-required-name-10580.test.tsx` | TYPE: `RefreshIndicator` with no `ariaLabel` sits under `@ts-expect-error`, checked by the package's `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. DOM: the bar is named with exactly the passed string, and a caller that casts past the type gets no `aria-label` at all, so there is no English fallback left. |
| `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.refreshIndicatorLocale-10580.test.tsx` | `de`: the bar is named `Wird aktualisiert…` during a bus-driven re-read. `en` control: `Refreshing…`. |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.refreshIndicatorLocale-10580.test.tsx` | `zh`: `刷新中…` during a toolbar-refresh re-read. `en` control: `Refreshing…`. |
| `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.refreshIndicatorLocale-10580.test.tsx` | `zh`: `刷新中…` during a bus-driven re-read. `en` control: `Refreshing…`. |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectDataTable.refreshIndicatorLocale-10580.test.tsx` | `ja`: `更新中…` during a filter-change re-read. `en` control: `Refreshing…`. |

In every view pin the second query is held open by hand, so the bar is read while the query really is in flight. `ObjectGantt.refreshInPlace-7237.test.tsx` was run unchanged and stays green.

## Reverse verification (each leg ran from a committed state, with trap restore and restore proven by hash)

1. **Base leg.** The implementation files (the component, the four callers, the ten packs) were checked out at BASE `adeecd6`, with the pins taken from HEAD `7a1b619`. The 5 pin files then gave exit **1**, `Tests  9 failed | 3 passed (12)`. The failure dump reads `aria-label="Refreshing"` on the progress bar. On-disk proof of the mutation: the default literal counted 1 and the grid caller's name counted 0. After the restore (`git checkout HEAD --`), `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes and all 15 paths were hash-equal to their HEAD blobs. The same 5 files at HEAD gave exit **0**, `Tests  12 passed (12)`.
2. **Type leg.** `ariaLabel?: string` was written back on disk (optional count 1, required count 0). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in `packages/components` then gave exit **2**, `error TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive.` at the pin. After the restore it gave exit **0**. `--listFiles` shows the pin file in that program (1 hit).
3. **Consumer leg** (proves the plugins read the rebuilt `dist/*.d.ts`, whose `refresh-indicator.d.ts` declares `ariaLabel: string;`). With `ObjectGrid`'s `ariaLabel` dropped on disk, `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/plugin-grid` gave exit **2**, `TS2741: Property 'ariaLabel' is missing in type '{ active: boolean; }' but required in type 'RefreshIndicatorProps'.` It was restored hash-equal.

- `… packages/plugin-list/ packages/plugin-charts/`: exit 0, `172 passed (172)`, `1982 passed`.
- `… packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/i18n/`: exit 0, `201 passed (201)`, `2424 passed`.
- `… packages/components/src/custom/` plus the components pin plus `ObjectGantt.refreshInPlace-7237.test.tsx`: exit 0, `2 passed (2)`, `11 passed`. `src/custom/` holds no test file.

Merged head `641ed9f`, after the merge of `origin/main` `6516320`, which moved all ten packs and `packages/components`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/` plus the 5 pins plus the gantt pin: exit 0, `77 passed (77)`, `1197 passed`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard --filter @object-ui/plugin-gantt --concurrency=2`: exit 0, `22 successful, 22 total`, with all 7 type-check tasks executed (cache miss).
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (no `refreshing` candidate), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` over the 20 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: exit 0, 0 errors.

**Lint, narrowed and declared.** The repo-wide `pnpm lint` was not run locally; CI owns it. Evidence that the narrowing excludes nothing: (1) `eslint.config.js` applies to `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, and every one of this diff's 20 `.ts`/`.tsx` files is in that population; (2) `--format json` reports 20 files linted, 0 errors; (3) the config has no `parserOptions`, `projectService` or `project:` (0 hits) and no import plugin (0 hits), so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict of any file it does not touch.

- Round 2: the branch merged `origin/main` `4a3d500` as `1a89050` (merge only; this PR's own diff is unchanged at 21 files, +543 / −8). There, the `plugin-list` suite plus the five pins and the `ObjectGantt` 7237 pin (104 files, 1166 tests), and the seven type-checks, re-ran green. The merge-queue eviction at 13:55Z was the objectui#10645 test, which is not this PR's (os-dev-report round 2, comment `5834284916`).
- Round 3: merged `origin/main` `7baede3` (it carries PR objectui#10677, the change for objectui#10645) at `a6512a7`, with no conflicts; the five pins, the `ObjectGantt` 7237 pin and the seven type-checks re-ran green there (os-dev-report round 3, comment `5836351479`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Hosts with no i18next instance.** A throwaway probe, not committed, rendered `ObjectChart` with no `I18nProvider`: the bar is named `chart.refreshing`, the key itself. `ObjectDataTable` reads its name the same way (`useObjectTranslation().t`) and was not measured separately. Grid, list and gantt still resolve English there through their own `createSafeTranslation` defaults maps. This is what "no English fallback" means at the two new call sites. The console mounts `I18nProvider` in `apps/console/src/main.tsx`, so it does not reach the console. The changeset says so.
- `RefreshIndicator` spreads `...props` after `aria-label`, so a caller's own `aria-label` attribute still overrides `ariaLabel`. That was true before this PR and is unchanged.
- The comment on the `chart` block in `en.ts` still describes the pack as budgeted inside the `framework` chunk. `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` now gives the pack its own `i18n-locale-en` ceiling. The comment has drifted and is not touched here.
- In `de`, `grid.refreshing` reads `Wird aktualisiert…` while `list.refreshing` reads `Aktualisiere…`. The two new keys use the former. This is polish and is not touched here.
